scope: Only saved P02 shift G/B/S records, existing nominal diagnostic and endpoint receipts. No sensor work, replay, or numerical evaluation.
supported_findings: All three shift policies execute the same 105 paid actions/poses and produce byte-identical complete meshes and occupancy containers.
All three apply 22 of 24 saved feedback attempts; lack of all geometric feedback is not the cause in this group.
Only one rack and one cabinet are observed; no qualified same-class peers occur. S rho stays 0.5 when defined and its instance-belief sequence equals B.
Cabinet obtains a qualified plane at paid step 11; rack never does. Rack forecasts all fall back; cabinet has positive forecasts and changing geometric evidence.
Semantic conditioning changes G versus B/S scores, but every scored diagnostic remains below the best direct option. Positive EVI alone never causes a paid diagnostic selection in this shift group.
The previous nominal diagnostic at step70 did narrowly outrank direct for B/S; that contrast is saved decision evidence, not a single-factor causal attribution across scenes.
